usedFor: Recall.ai transcribes your meetings, and Asana is where follow-up work lives. A “New Transcript Completed” in Recall.ai can run “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana, with an assignee, dates and a description.

bestTemplate.name: “New Transcript Completed” in Recall.ai, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A finished transcript is the point where action items exist. “Create Task or Subtask” takes an assignee, tags, dates and a description, so the task arrives ready to work.

watchOut: “New Transcript Completed” is polling, so tasks appear on a schedule. “New Webhook Event” fires on every status event, so that trigger can create duplicate tasks for one meeting.
